mantras.purpose: honor Brihaspati, preceptor of the gods
Ketu Gayatri for clarity through confusion
mantras.text: Om Ashvadhvajaya Vidmahe, Shulahastaya Dhimahi, Tanno Ketuh Prachodayat

mantras.purpose: strengthen Mars — courage, vitality, righteous action
strengthen Moon — calm mind, emotional balance
honor Soma, lord of the night
propitiate Rahu — steadiness amid worldly storms
Rahu Gayatri for focus through illusion
mantras.text: Om Nagadhvajaya Vidmahe, Padmahastaya Dhimahi, Tanno Rahuh Prachodayat

mantras.purpose: Shani Gayatri for steadiness under pressure
mantras.text: Om Kakadhvajaya Vidmahe, Khadgahastaya Dhimahi, Tanno Mandah Prachodayat

mantras.purpose: the Gayatri — illumination of the intellect; traditionally at dawn
mantras.text: Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah, Tat Savitur Varenyam, Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi, Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat

note: Devotional practice from the living Vedic tradition — symbolic and traditional, never medical and never a guaranteed remedy. Transliteration only; consult a teacher for pronunciation and initiation customs.
source: Traditional Navagraha mantras and planetary Gayatris; ancient public-domain verses as commonly transmitted
